outgoing.name: 15th century
outgoing.excerpt: In addition, he published a series of theological treatises and tracts concerning religious problems encountered in 15th century Spain.

outgoing.name: Judaism
outgoing.section: Activities as inquisitor and policy on conversion
outgoing.excerpt: Despite his laudable defense of converted Jews, Barrientos and, in general, the Dominican Order, supported the prohibition of Judaism in Castile.

outgoing.name: Philosophy
outgoing.excerpt: Following the completion of his education, he took a teaching position at the University of Salamanca, where he conducted classes in theology and philosophy.
